hook: Cheap leads are only half the story.
subtitle: ₹266 CPL. A fourteen-day quality read.

sections.title: The buyer challenge
sections.text: A low lead cost is not enough for a premium residential sales team. The useful question is how many enquiries meet the agreed sales-readiness standard and what happens after that assessment.

sections.title: The project context
sections.text: The historical portfolio reports more than 150 leads over fourteen days at approximately ₹266 per lead. It records 51% scored sales-ready by the client and about ₹2.75 crore in site-visit pipeline. These figures are owner-reported and have not been independently reconciled with platform and sales exports.

sections.title: The strategic approach
sections.text: The recorded approach combines a tight buyer catchment, distinct creative arguments and an agreed qualification standard. The value of that standard is consistency: cost and quality can be considered together rather than presenting form volume as the outcome.

sections.title: The creative direction
sections.text: Test price, location and proof as separate propositions, with the same quality definition across the test. At the reported 51% rate, ₹266 CPL implies approximately ₹522 per sales-ready lead. That is an illustrative calculation from the reported figures, not an additional independently measured result.

sections.title: What the creative test should answer
sections.text: Which of the price, location and proof arguments attracts prospects meeting the same sales-readiness standard? Does a lower lead cost remain useful after quality scoring? Can the recorded site-visit pipeline be reconciled with actual visit and sales records? These are the case’s recommended test questions, not measured winning variants. Compare them over a consistent period with a stable qualification definition. A creative should earn more distribution because it produces relevant next steps, not just because its headline generates curiosity.

sections.title: The sales hand-off
sections.text: Capture budget fit, North Bangalore interest, the agreed readiness criteria and accepted next steps. Keep those answers attached to the original enquiry so sales does not need to restart the conversation. Confirm that the assigned team receives the record and can add a clear outcome: unreachable, unsuitable, qualified, visit agreed or booked. This is the recommended hand-off for the brief; the available record does not establish a completed end-to-end reconciliation.

sections.title: From enquiry to a useful conversation
sections.text: The measurement framework separates an enquiry, a reachable prospect, a qualified conversation, an accepted site visit and a confirmed booking. Each stage needs its own definition and reporting window. A lead is not automatically a qualified buyer, and a visit is not a completed transaction. For this case, the next useful measurement step is to reconcile campaign enquiries with the sales record, retaining the source message and configuration wherever available. This describes the evaluation framework, not a claim that every step has been completed.

When a portfolio number is used in a presentation, keep its scope visible so it cannot be mistaken for the result of a single development.

hook: One configuration. A cleaner buyer signal.
subtitle: A focused Kogilu proposition.

sections.title: The buyer challenge
sections.text: When a campaign mixes incompatible configurations, enquiry volume can favour the cheapest option rather than the inventory the sales team needs to discuss. A focused configuration makes the proposition clearer.

sections.title: The project context

sections.title: The strategic approach
sections.text: Build one configuration-led story, then test the reasons a buyer might choose it: home suitability, location and community preference. Keep the advertised promise aligned with qualification questions, so the person responding understands the product before the first call.

sections.title: The creative direction
sections.text: Use the authentic Vajram mark on a white background with adequate contrast. Create distinct message families without changing the underlying offer. Location claims need verified distances; do not substitute metro-adjacency language from a different project. Connect enquiry delivery to the current sales workflow before interpreting the campaign as successful.

Compare them over a consistent period with a stable qualification definition.
